visual_geometry.note: scene_geometry.visual_path is a CoppeliaSim object path, not proof of a local STL/CAD mesh.

collision_geometry.name: GunCollisionHull
collision_geometry.note: Four convex components are suitable for collision checking, not for identifying a conductive-tip centre.

tcp_geometry.note: WeldTCP and the nearest hull vertex are not accepted as a measured nozzle/contact-tip centre without physical confirmation.

wire_geometry.derived_axis_policy: Do not infer the physical feed axis from a collision-hull nearest vertex.

required_physical_measurements: flange->nozzle/conductive-tip centre XYZ in a documented flange frame
two measured points along the actual wire/feed axis (axis direction and sign)
wire stick-out length from the measured nozzle/contact point
tool orientation/reference used by the pendant TCP
